sections.heading: Kérdőszavak – Basic Question Words
paragraphs: Hungarian uses simple question words to ask about people, things, places, time, reasons, and methods.
These words are essential when talking about schedules, dates, or planning activities.

sections.heading: Idő és dátum – Time and Date
paragraphs: To ask about times, Hungarian commonly uses 'mikor' and expressions with '-kor'.
Days of the week and months help you discuss schedules.
